forecast_top.conviction_note: mode-of-week is the date the line KEEPS landing on. `avg` is the mean of a bimodal distribution and can name a week no sweep ever called.
forecast_top.drift_note: drift_shape and drift_7d SUBTRACT the +1 day/day calendar walk that a frozen curve produces because start_date is today. drift_endpoint does not, which is why it reads ~5 and the 'stable' badge never fires.
forecast_top.geometry_note: the extremum is at week 0 - this is the low/high of the projection path AT ITS START, not a dated cycle call
forecast_top.sample_note: `sample` counts SWEEPS, not independent calls - these are hourly clones of a slow-moving curve. Read mode_count against unique_days, not against sample.
